direction_convention: PR87 state-relative per-parameter-tensor Gaussian direction with RMS=max(parameter RMS,1e-3); the identical parameter direction is used in regimes A-E
perturbation_scope: network parameters only; optimizer, EMA, scaler and all discrete input-state coordinates are held at the common baseline in regime D

regimes.A_squared_gn_fp32: J_i^T (J_i-J_j) u; squared-loss Gauss-Newton harness baseline
regimes.B_real_loss_gn_fp32: J_i^T H_rho0(r) (J_i-J_j) u; c=0 and zero-residual cells fail closed
regimes.C_full_field_fp32: complete recompute-and-detach c=0 gradient field with network force_fp32=True
regimes.D_production_algorithmic: parameter-direction partial finite difference of internal-FP16 plus GradScaler/RAdam/EMA transition
regimes.E_full_field_pseudohuber_fp32: complete recompute-and-detach FP32 field with fixed c=0.06 diagnostic smoothing

requirements: regime A passes the frozen 5 percent convergence gate
source parameters and algorithmic state are preserved
positive and negative branches start from the same base state

matrix: 4 arms x 2 audit minibatches x 4 directions x 5 regimes
independent_unit_note: batch, direction, epsilon and regime are paired local repeated measurements, not independent training replicates
